text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Android Developer position at Ember Mobility. With a solid foundation in frontend and mobile development, along with a user-centered design background from my B.Des in Interaction Design at Lakeside School of Design, I am eager to contribute to your team.

While my background is rooted in React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React Native, I am a quick learner who is highly motivated to apply my skills to the mobile ecosystem at Ember Mobility, including Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and MVVM architecture. My experience spans building functional applications, managing state, and deploying software to users. For instance, I built a recipe finder app in React Native using Expo with offline favourites, and I successfully published it on the Play Store, where it has achieved over 1,000 installs.

In my freelance work as a Frontend Developer, I have focused on translating design into performance. I built seven marketing websites for small businesses using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, ensuring that all of them score 95+ on Lighthouse. Additionally, I turned Figma designs into reusable React components and a small design system, and I developed a café menu page that reads items from a Google Sheet. These projects demonstrate my ability to deliver fast, accessible, and polished user interfaces.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my design background, development experience, and passion for building user-focused applications align with the needs of Ember Mobility. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
